description: This Java class `ProductImageDescription` models the description of product images within an e-commerce domain, extending a general `Description` class, and mapping to the `PRODUCT_IMAGE_DESCRIPTION` database table with JPA annotations.

classes.name: ProductImageDescription
classes.description: A JPA entity representing descriptions for product images, including an alternate text tag and a many-to-one relationship with `ProductImage`.

methods.name: getAltTag
methods.description: Returns the alternate text for the image.

methods.name: setAltTag
methods.description: Sets the alternate text for the image.
